name: Runner Extras - Query Column Wildcard Filter
brief: Issue #2299: Query.SetFilter with a wildcard on a Query column threw InvalidCastException (NCLMetaQueryColumn -> NCLMetaField) at Read().
description: NavQuery.SetFilter stores the filter keyed by the NCLMetaQueryColumn; the runner retargets each FilterExpression to the column's SourceTableField before handing the request to BC's TempTableDataProvider, but RetargetFilterExpression only knew Unary and Binary expressions and silently passed a WildcardFilterExpression (and a RangeFilterExpression) through still bound to the query column, which BC's RecordBufferEvaluatorVisitor then cast to NCLMetaField. This suite proves the wildcard, negated-wildcard, range, and no-match cases on an application-local table, plus the SetRange control. The oracle row counts were measured on a real BC 28.4 service tier in the issue; the plain-BC claim belongs upstream in the corpus.
